newsitem.title: UK: NatWest hires Baia as Emerging Markets head trader.
newsitem.headline: NatWest hires Baia as Emerging Markets head trader.

text.p: NatWest Markets said it hired Paulo Baia as Senior Vice President and Chief Trader of Emerging Markets in its Global Financial Markets division.
Baia joins NatWest from Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette where he was responsible for Brazil Local Markets Trading in the Emerging Markets Group there since 1995.
Prior to that, Baia spent nine years at Bankers Trust Company in its Latin America Merchant Banking Group.
Based in New York, Baia will report to Pierre Durand, Managing Director of Emerging Markets, who also joined NatWest just last month from Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette.
"Paulo's specialized expertise will further strengthen our presence in emerging markets," said Howard Kurz, NatWest's Head of Global Foreign Exchange in London.
NatWest's Global Financial Markets division covers global foreign exchange, money markets, FX options and interest rate risk management.
